features.title: Curated Webb Gallery
features.body: Webb's greatest images — the Cosmic Cliffs, the Pillars of Creation, deep fields and more — grouped into collections and shown with their real captions, credits, distances, and sky coordinates. Search for any target.

features.title: Where Is Webb
features.body: A status dashboard for the telescope itself: how long it's been in space, its orbit 1.5 million km (about a million miles) away at Lagrange Point 2, and the astonishing gap between its sun-facing side and its supercooled instruments.

features.title: 4K Wallpapers
features.body: Save any Webb image as a 4K wallpaper for your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV — straight from the source, at full resolution. Part of Solar Beam Premium.

features.title: Picture of the Day
features.body: NASA picks one image of the cosmos every day. Solar Beam puts the Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) front and center — and when you want the science, one tap generates plain-language AI facts about what you're looking at.

features.title: Asteroid Tracker
features.body: See what's passing Earth in real time: how close each asteroid comes, how fast it moves, and the size of impact it would leave. Charts sort the dangerous from the safe — always free, never gated.

features.title: Five platforms, one app
features.body: A native app on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Vision Pro — with a menu bar ticker on Mac, Ambient Mode on every screen, and Spatial Scenes on Vision Pro. Premium is a universal purchase: unlock it on one device and it works on all of them, with Family Sharing.

faq.q: What makes Solar Beam's James Webb gallery special?
faq.a: It's a curated gallery of the telescope's best images — not a raw data dump. Each image comes with its real caption, credit, distance, instruments, and sky coordinates, grouped into collections (nebulae, galaxies, deep fields, the solar system, and more), and you can search for any target. A "Where Is Webb" dashboard shows the telescope's mission status alongside it.

Solar Beam is a single universal app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Vision Pro, and it's free on all of them. Premium is a universal purchase: one subscription or one lifetime unlock covers every device you own, and it's family-shareable. It's native on each — a menu bar ticker on Mac, Ambient Mode everywhere, and Spatial Scenes on Vision Pro.

faq.q: How much does Solar Beam cost?
faq.a: Solar Beam is free to download, and the daily NASA picture, the asteroid tracker and the "Where Is Webb" dashboard are always free. Premium is optional: $2.99 a month, $19.99 a year with a 1-week free trial, or $49.99 once for lifetime access. Subscriptions auto-renew until you cancel in your App Store account; the lifetime unlock never renews. All options are family-shareable and cover every Apple device.

faq.q: What do I get for free versus Premium?
faq.a: Free covers today's picture, the near-Earth asteroid tracker, the "Where Is Webb" dashboard, the first 60 images of the curated Webb gallery, a rolling 30-day archive of past pictures, and 3 AI-generated fact sets for the life of the install. Premium unlocks the complete Webb gallery, 4K wallpapers and full-resolution downloads, Ambient Mode, the full Picture of the Day archive, Spatial Scenes on Vision Pro, and unlimited AI facts. Asteroid tracking is never gated.

faq.q: Is there a subscription or in-app purchase?
faq.a: Only if you want more. The app is free. Premium is $2.99 a month or $19.99 a year with a 1-week free trial — both auto-renewing until cancelled — or a $49.99 one-time lifetime unlock that never renews. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account. The daily picture and asteroid tracker stay free either way.

faq.q: Where do the images and data come from?
faq.a: From NASA's public APIs and the ESA/Webb archive: the Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD), James Webb Space Telescope imagery (ESA/Webb, CC BY 4.0), and near-Earth object data. Image credits: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI. Solar Beam is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA or ESA.

faq.q: Can I really set Webb images as wallpaper?
faq.a: Yes. With Premium, save any Webb image at 4K — desktop and mobile sizes — and set it as your wallpaper on iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV. Free sharing is at display resolution.

faq.q: What does Solar Beam collect about me?
faq.a: There's no account and no third-party tracking. The app records purchase history so a Premium unlock can follow you across your devices; it isn't linked to your identity and is never used for tracking. Everything else — the images you browse, what you save — stays on your device. The full policy is linked at the bottom of this page.
